market_specific_notes: Chicago shoppers often see offices advertise quick bookings, but the stronger local comparison is who explains the full process clearly.
The most useful city-level difference is whether the clinic can handle forms, vaccines, and expected turnaround in one workflow.
local_vetting_points: Ask whether the clinic handles vaccines onsite or sends you elsewhere.
Ask what usually causes packet delays in Chicago-area cases.
Ask whether the office explains cost by stage or only gives one headline number.

payment_options: Confirm whether card, cash, or HSA/FSA-style payment is accepted.
